headline: KRAKEN GROWS: VIRIDIAN DRILLS BROAD CU-NI-CO MINERALIZATION ACROSS 3KM IN LABRADOR — 33 Holes Done, NI 43-101 Target Set for January 2027
snippet: Viridian Metals (CSE: VRDN) released its 2026 Kraken Main program wrap-up on November 20, confirming 33 of 50 planned diamond drill holes are complete on its copper-nickel-cobalt project in Labrador, with broad near-surface massive and disseminated sulphide mineralization continuing across a 3-kilometre system corridor — assays from 25 holes remain outstanding, and an updated NI 43-101 Exploration Target based on the full dataset is expected in January 2027. The 2026 program was designed to systematically infill between widely spaced prior holes and test the mineralized system at depth, building toward a formal resource estimate on a property with an initial conceptual exploration target of 41–61 million tonnes grading 0.35–0.52% copper equivalent — a target the January update is expected to significantly revise given the expanded footprint now confirmed.

headline: LITHIUM AFRICA DISCOVERS NEW PEGMATITE SYSTEM 11km FROM NORRABEES — Jackal Water Returns 2.21% Li2O; District-Scale Springbok Footprint Doubles
snippet: Lithium Africa (TSX-V: LAF) announced November 20 that its proprietary machine-learning-assisted targeting identified a new spodumene-bearing lithium pegmatite system at Jackal Water — 11 kilometres from its known Norrabees cluster at the Springbok Project in South Africa's Northern Cape — with the first holes returning up to 2.21% Li2O, establishing district-scale potential across the 1,675 km² prospecting right. The discovery significantly expands the mineralised footprint beyond the existing Norrabees inferred resource and positions Springbok as a multi-cluster lithium district rather than a single-deposit asset, at a time when the company has begun selecting equipment for an on-site dense media separation plant targeting first spodumene concentrate output in H2 2027.

headline: BRAZILIAN RARE EARTHS HITS 13.2% TREO PEAK AT PELÉ SOUTH — Major 2.5km Discovery Corridor Opens; Diamond Rigs Testing Hard-Rock Below
snippet: Brazilian Rare Earths (ASX: BRE) announced on November 18 a major new discovery at the Pelé South target, with systematic auger drilling confirming thick high-grade rare earth zones exceeding 10% total rare earth oxides (TREO) from surface across a corridor of more than 2.5 kilometres — the best interval returned 6 metres at 13.2% TREO — most holes ended in mineralisation at mechanical refusal, indicating depth extension potential into fresh rock, and diamond core rigs are now drilling beneath the strongest anomalies to test hard-rock grade continuity. The Pelé South corridor is entirely separate from and additional to the Pelé Target 1 system (which returned up to 13.5% TREO in diamond holes in 2025), materially expanding the total rare earth endowment at a property already regarded as one of the highest-grade undeveloped REE projects globally, in a year when rare earth supply chain security has become a US and Western allied governments policy priority.

headline: GOLIATH DRILLS 13.45 g/t AuEq AT SUREBET'S GOLDEN GATE ZONE — High-Grade BC Golden Triangle System Expands Another 130 Metres
snippet: Goliath Resources (TSX-V: GOT) reported on November 17 that hole GD-26-478 at the Golddigger property in British Columbia's Golden Triangle intersected 4.85 metres grading 13.45 g/t gold equivalent — including a higher-grade sub-interval — in the Golden Gate Zone of its Surebet gold discovery, while a step-out position extends the zone's known strike by 130 metres in a direction that remains open for further expansion. The continued high-grade expansion of the Golden Gate feeder zone, which has now been delineated over more than 1.3 kilometres of strike, anchors Surebet as one of the most active high-grade vein gold discoveries in the Golden Triangle — a region that produced Pretium's Brucejack, Seabridge's KSM, and several other multi-million-ounce discoveries — and the results will inform a 2027 resource update on a system where drilling assays continue to track above the 10 g/t AuEq threshold needed to support underground development economics.

headline: GENESIS AND VAULT MERGE TO CREATE AUSTRALIA'S THIRD-LARGEST GOLD MINER — Court Approves Scheme; 600-700koz Combined Producer Goes Live Nov 17
snippet: The Western Australian Supreme Court approved the scheme of arrangement for Genesis Minerals' (ASX: GMD) acquisition of Vault Minerals (ASX: VAU) on November 17, 2026, with Vault shares suspended from ASX trading at close of trading that same day — creating an ASX-listed combined company with annual gold production of 600,000–700,000 ounces from operations across the Murchison and Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, ranking it as Australia's third-largest gold producer behind Newmont's Australian operations and Northern Star Resources. The deal consolidates two Tier 1-district gold portfolios and positions the merged entity as a medium-term development candidate for the high-capital regional infrastructure investments that individual companies at the 300-350koz scale cannot justify alone.

headline: STANDARD URANIUM CONFIRMS BOTH URANIUM AND RARE EARTHS AT ROCAS, SASK — First Drilling Hits REE Up to 0.99% Alongside Uranium Anomalies
snippet: Standard Uranium (TSX-V: STND) confirmed uranium mineralization and rare earth element enrichment from the first four drill holes at its Rocas project in Saskatchewan on November 17, with rare earth grades up to 0.99% TREO and uranium anomalies in two of four holes — an unusual double-commodity hit in first-ever drilling that positions Rocas as a potential REE-uranium dual target within the Athabasca Basin's southern margin geology. While the uranium grades are weakly anomalous pending chemical assay confirmation, the discovery of significant rare earth concentrations alongside uranium mineralisation in Precambrian basement rock is consistent with the geological setting that has produced both commodity types at properties along the basin's periphery, and positions Standard Uranium's property portfolio at a moment when REE-uranium combined assets are attracting renewed investor attention following US rare earth policy escalation.

headline: WGC FLAGS 'DOLLAR-YIELD DOUBLE WHAMMY' AS GOLD BREAKS $3,800 — Fourth Straight Down Session Nov 18; Fed Minutes Confirm December Hike
snippet: USA Gold's November 18 daily precious metals report documented gold breaking below $3,800 to its lowest level since September 2025 — a fourth consecutive down session — citing the World Gold Council's framing of a 'dollar-yield double whammy': a simultaneously strengthening US dollar (driven by hawkish Fed rate expectations) and rising real Treasury yields combining to suppress gold from both the currency and opportunity-cost angles at once. With silver falling 3% to $46.38 on the same session, traders are watching whether the November 18 close below $3,800 triggers further technical selling before the December FOMC meeting, or whether central bank accumulation programs activate at or below the $3,750 structural support level that multiple institutions have cited as a probable buying target.

headline: CHILE'S $111B MINING INVESTMENT PIPELINE THROUGH 2035 — Lithium Doubles to $12B; Copper Holds 84.5% at $94B in New Cochilco Projection
snippet: Chile's state copper commission Cochilco projects US$111.149 billion in mining investment between 2026 and 2035, with lithium investment set to nearly double from recent levels as the country accelerates its critical minerals strategy — copper still represents 84.5% of the pipeline at approximately US$94 billion, while lithium's share has grown materially on the back of new State Lithium Company (CODELCO-led) and private operator project commitments. For junior mining investors, the scale of Chile's planned exploration and development spending signals that the structural supply-side response to AI-infrastructure-driven copper demand is unambiguously underway in the world's largest copper-producing nation, even as current commodity prices and equity markets are caught in a Fed-driven correction cycle that has suppressed near-term capital formation.

headline: RICK RULE AND JEFF PHILLIPS: 'MINERS FALLING 2-3X HARDER THAN GOLD IS EXACTLY WHERE YOU BUILD' — Generational Miner-Metal Disconnect Analysis
snippet: Discovery Alert's November 2026 analysis — featuring input from veteran resource investors Rick Rule and Jeff Phillips — examines why gold mining equities are falling two to three times harder than the underlying gold price in the current correction, with the VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) down over 40% from its 2026 peak while gold itself has corrected approximately 29%; both analysts identify the extreme miner-to-metal price disconnect — with P/NAV ratios at decade lows — as the entry condition they look for before deploying capital into the sector. The analysis frames the current selloff as a forced liquidation and financial-conditions-driven de-leveraging event rather than a fundamental deterioration in mining company profitability, arguing that the operational leverage which amplified losses on the way down will amplify gains on the way up once the Fed cycle turns and capital flows back to the sector.

headline: LAHONTAN GOLD CONFIRMS 0.34 g/t AU HEAP LEACH GRADES AT SANTA FE PAD 2, NEVADA — Final Sonic Drill Results Support Recovery Economics Ahead of Production Decision
snippet: Lahontan Gold (TSX-V: LG) announced on November 17 that final sonic drill results from heap leach pad two at its Santa Fe gold project in Nevada returned a weighted average gold grade of 0.34 g/t — confirming the original estimated grade and supporting the heap leach recovery economics underpinning the company's preliminary economic assessment. For TSX-V investors evaluating Nevada gold development-stage companies in the current correction environment, the grade confirmation at an existing processed-material heap leach pad represents a low-capital near-term production pathway: processing already-mined and partially leached ore at grades above typical open-pit economic cut-offs, in a jurisdiction with established permitting precedent and no requirement for new mine construction before first gold pour.
